inspiration.observed_pattern: The accepted CONV scenario exposed that MySqweel rejected a single scalar hexadecimal-to-decimal conversion while MariaDB returned the converted text.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one deterministic CONV expression so the missing function path and its signed target-base handling remain directly regression-testable.

fixture_notes: One scalar conversion isolates the original unsupported-function mismatch without tables or nondeterministic inputs.
determinism_notes: The query contains only fixed literals and no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections.
